paragraphsEn: Saturnalia999 is a multidisciplinary artist based in Chile — Music, Magick, Bodymod, Performance. Active in the underground gothic scene since 2009 with Saturnalia as voice, composer, lyrics, performance and violin being the sole official member, collaborating with multiple underground musicians, producers and support members worldwide.

Her first songs from 2009 were archived and paved the way for early collaborations. In 2012, Saturnalia's online friend ONIMORTIS (based in the UK) contributed beats that would evolve into her signature industrial darkwave sound. Following demo EPs and the early release of 'Necrosis', she rebuilt her artistic path with a singular visual and musical identity.

Her debut full-length album 'WHY TO LIVE FOR A DREAM?' was released on Halloween 2023 with 13 original compositions, followed by the expanded Deluxe Edition in 2024. Her second full-length album 'CAN YOU BE HONEST FOR ONCE?' arrived on Halloween 2024, followed by 'Why to Sing Beautifully?', establishing Saturnalia999 as a vital voice in South American dark alternative music.
paragraphsEs: Saturnalia999 es una artista multidisciplinaria radicada en Chile — Música, Magia, Bodymod, Performance. Activa en la escena underground gótica desde 2009 con Saturnalia a cargo de voz, composición, letras, performance y violín como única integrante oficial, colaborando con múltiples productores y músicos de apoyo a nivel internacional.

Sus primeras composiciones de 2009 sentaron las bases de su sonido. En 2012, ONIMORTIS (residente en Reino Unido) aportó ritmos que moldearon su característico estilo darkwave e industrial. Tras demos tempranos y el lanzamiento de 'Necrosis', refundó su camino estético con una identidad sonora y visual inconfundible.

Su álbum debut de larga duración 'WHY TO LIVE FOR A DREAM?' vio la luz en Halloween de 2023 con 13 canciones originales, seguido de su edición Deluxe en 2024. Su segundo álbum de estudio 'CAN YOU BE HONEST FOR ONCE?' se estrenó en Halloween de 2024, continuado por 'Why to Sing Beautifully?', consolidando a Saturnalia999 como una referente esencial del darkwave experimental sudamericano.
